rationale.readings: Taken on the Intel i5-8259U build host (8 logical CPUs, 8 GiB) between 21:48 BRT on 2026-11-19 and 00:47 BRT on 2026-11-20 (00:48 to 03:47 UTC on 2026-11-20). A job is refused for signs of present stress; sizes that record earlier pressure only warn.
rationale.max_load_percent_of_cpus: Refuses. 6.00 on 8 CPUs: the 1-minute load average read 2.42-4.96 without a native build and 6.11-14 with overlapping loads. A job waits default_wait_seconds first, so only a load that stays high refuses it.
rationale.memory_pressure: Refuses unless kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level is normal; no threshold to set. The warning level was logged 20:36-20:50 BRT on 2026-11-19. The level was normal with swap at 1551 MiB during one build, at 1016 MiB during another and at 1193 MiB on an idle host.
rationale.thermal: Refuses when pmset -g therm reports CPU_Speed_Limit or CPU_Scheduler_Limit below 100, or fewer CPUs available; no threshold to set. CPU_Speed_Limit read 100 without a build and 81 during the first serial build after the reboot.
rationale.foreign_compilers: Refuses. One serial build read a load of 4.24-7.12, inside the range measured without one, so only the process name identifies a compiler started outside the lease.
rationale.warn_swap_used_mib: Warns only. macOS keeps swap allocated after the pressure that filled it has ended, so the value records history: it read 190-696 MiB without a native build, 1016-1551 MiB during one serial iOS build, and 1193 MiB on an idle host with normal memory pressure (00:32 BRT on 2026-11-20), where a limit of 1024 MiB gave a refusal with nothing running. 1600 is above every reading.
rationale.warn_compressor_percent_of_memory: Warns only, for the same reason. vm.compressor_bytes_used read 368-1807 MiB (4-22% of 8 GiB), and memory pressure was normal at both ends of that range. 25 is above every reading. The larger 'stored in compressor' figure of vm_stat (3978 MiB when this one read 466 MiB) is a different quantity and is not read.
rationale.default_wait_seconds: Judgment call. The 1-minute load average needs about a minute to fall after a job ends; no settle time was measured.
rationale.child_niceness: Judgment call. Its effect was not measured.
